passages.text: The workspace helps a writer improve a job description without losing the wording that was already approved. The editor track changes and store each revision. Each revision keeps it's original sentence beside the new sentence so a reviewer can see what shifted. Reviewers look their for the reason a change was made, even when the reason is only a short comment.

after: A change can start from a suggestion or from the writer, the system still stores both the same way. The writer may also attach a note about tone. That note is optional. The page number is not optional, because a later reader has to find the passage in the file that was reviewed.
